name: Neutrl USD
oneLiner: NUSD is Neutrl's synthetic dollar backed by liquid stablecoins and delta-hedged OTC positions; 1:1 mint/redeem via USDC, USDT, or USDe.
collateral: Accountable currently shows reserves concentrated in liquid stablecoins, with smaller OTC aggregate and other hedged reserve assets; Neutrl describes NUSD as a fully collateralized synthetic dollar backed by delta-neutral strategies and other crypto assets
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint and redeem via permissionless router using USDC, USDT, or USDe; peg maintained by arbitrage incentives, delta hedging of derivatives positions, and rapid reserve deployment from liquid stablecoin buffer

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata indicates a direct issuer, admin, proxy, pause, burn, or upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: NUSD is a synthetic delta-neutral dollar whose token carries a MINTER_ROLE, a DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and a denylist; mint is routed through Neutrl's Router.sol (1:1 vs USDC/USDT/USDe with a per-block cap) into custodied reserves, while redemption is KYC-gated. A single admin controls minter and denylist roles.

controls.label: NUSD token MINTER_ROLE (Router/Minter)
controls.capDescription: NUSD is minted only by holders of MINTER_ROLE; in practice the Router.sol mint() flow pulls collateral into AssetReserve.sol and a Minter contract issues NUSD 1:1, with a maxMintPerBlock rate limit.

routeChecks.rateLimits: Mint enforces maxMintPerBlock to limit per-block issuance.
routeChecks.signingModel: Mint is permissionless via Router.sol; redemption is restricted to KYC/KYB-approved counterparties (asymmetric design).

controls.evidence: Etherscan ABI for the NUSD token shows MINTER_ROLE, mint/burn, and denylist functions; Neutrl docs describe Router.sol mint() routing collateral to AssetReserve.sol with a maxMintPerBlock cap and KYC-gated redemption.

controls.label: NUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (token admin)
controls.capDescription: The NUSD token admin (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, with transferAdmin/acceptAdmin) can grant/revoke MINTER_ROLE and DENYLIST_MANAGER_ROLE, concentrating mint-authorization and denylist control in a single admin.
controls.evidence: Etherscan shows the NUSD constructor took an _admin parameter resolving to 0xE78615F841c3C013173FBE7679d17442C8673Cc1, with SingleAdminAccessControl (transferAdmin/acceptAdmin) over MINTER_ROLE and DENYLIST_MANAGER_ROLE.

review.evidence: Etherscan reads of the NUSD token show MINTER_ROLE, a SingleAdminAccessControl admin (constructor _admin 0xE78615...3Cc1), and denylist roles; Neutrl docs describe permissionless Router.sol minting 1:1 against liquid stablecoins with a per-block cap and KYC-gated redemption, backed by delta-neutral/OTC strategies held at custodians.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Token-level MINTER_ROLE/admin and Router mint flow confirmed from Etherscan and Neutrl docs; whether the admin is an EOA, multisig, or Safe was not verified on-chain, so EOA is recorded conservatively pending confirmation.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm whether the NUSD admin address 0xE78615F841c3C013173FBE7679d17442C8673Cc1 is an EOA, multisig, or Safe, and resolve the live MINTER_ROLE holder (Router/Minter contract) before raising confidence.
